root_cause_analysis.summary: The fuzzed font controls the sbix strike and glyph image offset arrays. During subsetting, HarfBuzz derives a strike pointer from the sbix strike table, then validates adjacent imageOffsetsZ entries before computing a glyph data length and copying glyph bytes. The vulnerable validation checked ordering and the end offset against the sbix table length, but it did not reject null image offset entries. A malformed sbix table can therefore drive the code to derive a glyph record pointer/range that resolves into HarfBuzz null/global storage and then read past it in hb_array_t::copy, producing the observed global-buffer-overflow.
root_cause_analysis.why_patch_works: The patch adds explicit is_null checks for imageOffsetsZ[old_gid] and imageOffsetsZ[old_gid + 1] before the ordering, size, and available_len checks. Rejecting those malformed offset entries at the root-cause branch prevents construction of the invalid SBIXGlyph pointer and prevents the downstream array copy from reading outside the valid glyph data range.
